title: Submit volunteer interest from the public homepage
description: A visitor can review campaign information on the homepage and submit the volunteer form successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll through campaign information
Fill in the volunteer form with valid information
Submit the volunteer form
Verify a submission completion message is visible

title: Submit an RSVP form from the public homepage
description: A public visitor can submit the RSVP form for a campaign event on the landing page and see a completion state afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the RSVP name field with a valid name
Fill in the RSVP email field with a valid email
Select a valid campaign event from the RSVP event field
Select a valid attendance option
Submit the RSVP form
Verify an RSVP submission confirmation is visible

title: Sign in to the admin dashboard
description: An authenticated admin can sign in through the admin login page and reach the protected dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/login
Fill in the admin email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the admin password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the admin dashboard is displayed

title: Set a new password for an invited admin
description: An invited admin can complete the password setup flow and see confirmation that the password was updated.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/update-password
Fill in the new password field with a valid password
Fill in the password confirmation field with the same password
Submit the password setup form
Verify a password update confirmation is visible

title: Require authentication before accessing admin pages
description: A visitor who is not signed in is prevented from opening protected admin pages and is sent to the login gate.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Verify the admin login page is displayed
Navigate to /admin/events
Verify the admin login page is displayed

title: Block unauthenticated access to the admin area
description: A visitor who is not signed in is prevented from viewing protected admin pages and is directed to authenticate.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Verify the admin login page is displayed

title: Add a new campaign event
description: An authenticated admin can create a new event in the events manager and see it appear in the event list after saving.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/login
Fill in the admin email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the admin password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open event management
Click the control to add a new event
Fill in a valid event title
Fill in a valid event date
Fill in a valid event time
Fill in a valid event location
Save the event
Verify the new event appears in the event list

title: Edit an existing upcoming event
description: An authenticated admin can update an upcoming event and see the revised details in the events list.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/login
Fill in the admin email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the admin password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open event management
Select an upcoming event to edit
Update the event title
Save the event changes
Verify the updated event information is displayed

title: Filter volunteers by status
description: An authenticated admin can filter the volunteer list by status and see only matching volunteers.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/login
Fill in the admin email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the admin password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open volunteer management
Choose a volunteer status filter
Verify the volunteer list is filtered by the selected status

title: Update attendance for a past event
description: An authenticated admin can record attendance for a past event and see the updated attendance state after saving.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/login
Fill in the admin email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the admin password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open event management
Switch to the past events view
Select a past event to update attendance
Set the actual attendance value
Save the attendance update
Verify the updated attendance state is displayed

title: Mark a volunteer as contacted
description: An authenticated admin can change a volunteer to contacted and see the updated status in the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/login
Fill in the admin email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the admin password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open volunteer management
Select a volunteer to mark as contacted
Mark the volunteer as contacted
Verify the volunteer status is updated to contacted

title: View events on the admin calendar
description: An authenticated admin can open the event calendar, see event days highlighted, and select a date to view matching event details.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/login
Fill in the admin email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the admin password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open event management
Open the event calendar
Select a date with scheduled events
Verify matching event details are displayed

title: Mark a volunteer as done
description: An authenticated admin can change a volunteer to done and see the updated status in the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/login
Fill in the admin email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the admin password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open volunteer management
Select a volunteer to mark as done
Mark the volunteer as done
Verify the volunteer status is updated to done

title: Review campaign information on the public landing page
description: A public visitor can read the campaign information on the homepage and see the main public content sections.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the campaign information section
Verify campaign information is displayed
Verify the public forms are available

title: View audit logs for recent admin changes
description: An authenticated admin can open the audit log page and review recent event and volunteer changes with the associated admin email.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/login
Fill in the admin email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the admin password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open audit logs
Verify recent audit log entries are displayed
Verify admin email references are displayed

title: Show an error for invalid admin credentials
description: An admin sees an error message when submitting invalid login credentials and is not signed in.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/login
Fill in the email field with invalid credentials
Fill in the password field with invalid credentials
Submit the login form
Verify a login error message is visible

title: Reject mismatched password confirmation during setup
description: An invited admin entering mismatched passwords on the password setup page sees a validation error and cannot complete the update.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/update-password
Fill in the new password field with a valid password
Fill in the password confirmation field with a different password
Submit the password update form
Verify a password confirmation validation error is visible

title: Show validation for an incomplete volunteer form
description: A visitor sees validation feedback when required volunteer form fields are left empty or invalid and the form is not submitted.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll through campaign information
Submit the volunteer form without completing required fields
Verify a volunteer form validation error is visible

title: Show validation for an incomplete RSVP form
description: A visitor sees validation feedback when required RSVP form fields are left empty or invalid and the form is not submitted.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll through campaign information
Submit the RSVP form without completing required fields
Verify an RSVP form validation error is visible

title: Show validation for mismatched password confirmation
description: An invited admin sees validation feedback when the password confirmation does not match and the password is not updated.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/update-password
Fill in the new password field with a valid password
Fill in the password confirmation field with a different password
Submit the password setup form
Verify a password confirmation validation error is visible

title: Reject an invalid admin login attempt
description: An unauthenticated user entering invalid admin credentials sees a login validation error and remains on the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/login
Fill in the admin email field with an invalid email
Fill in the admin password field with an invalid password
Submit the login form
Verify a login validation error is visible
